name: mini-dock
description: A small dock above the Claude Code prompt: a pixel pet, a context window bar and usage rings.

plugins.name: dock
plugins.description: /dock shows or hides the pet, the context bar and the usage rings together or one at a time; installs all three.

plugins.name: pixel-pet
plugins.description: A tiny pixel critter that reacts to your session, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt.

plugins.name: status-ring
